examples.arabic: شفت الوان كتير حلوه في المحل بس كنت عايز لون غامق
examples.english: I saw many beautiful colors in the shop but I wanted a dark color.
examples.transliteration: shuft alwaan kitir hilwa fi el mahal bas kunt aayiz loon ghaami

examples.arabic: الكوباية سخنة و لون القهوة غامق جميل
examples.english: The cup is hot and the coffee color is beautifully dark.
examples.transliteration: El kobaya sokhna w loon el ahwa ghameq gameel

examples.arabic: ايه رايك في اللون ده يا احمد
examples.english: "What do you think of this color, Ahmed?"
examples.transliteration: "Eih ra'yak fi el loon da ya Ahmed?"
